fig4g: Associations of OXPHOS level, MYC activity and proliferation with the expression of fifteen BCL-2 family genes, in the groups of Fig. 1g, in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Each row is one linear model of the gene's expression on OXPHOS, MYC activity and proliferation, with intrinsic subtype, and with tumour purity and leukocyte fraction in TCGA-BRCA; each coefficient is in SD per SD with the other two held fixed, and every variable is rank-normalised within each cohort. MYC activity is scored on MYC_UP.V1_UP, a score with few proliferation genes; the other MYC activity scores are shown in Extended Data. Left, binding of BCL-xL and MCL1 by BH3-only proteins, from Chen et al. (2005): filled, binds; open, does not; blank, not yet verified. Signature sign: the direction in which each of the six signature genes enters the signature. § BH3-only proteins whose activity is switched after translation (BAD: off by phosphorylation; BID: on by cleavage to tBID). The signature was selected for its association with OXPHOS at fixed proliferation (Methods). OXPHOS priority is shown in Extended Data.
ed_e: As Fig. 4g, with OXPHOS scored as its priority within the mitochondrial programme (mitoPPS).
ed_f: As Fig. 4g, from models using the reference MYC activity score (Felsher), which correlates with proliferation at 0.61 to 0.70.
ed_g: The six-gene signature (S6) and its two variants, S5 (without BID) and S7 (with BMF), on the MYC activity score with few proliferation genes and on the reference score, with OXPHOS scored as level and as priority, in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Each cell gives the coefficient (SD per SD) and its 95% confidence interval. The signature was selected for its association with OXPHOS at fixed proliferation (Methods).
ed_h: Left, unadjusted Spearman correlations of the signature, its variants and fifteen BCL-2 family genes with OXPHOS (level and priority), four MYC activity scores and proliferation, in TCGA-BRCA (n = 938) and SCAN-B (n = 3,143). Right, the adjusted coefficients of Fig. 4g. The signature was selected for its association with OXPHOS at fixed proliferation (Methods).
